title: My recitation stars chart
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: At-Takathur, Al-Qari'ah, madd letters and shaddah
source: Written for quran/y2 lesson 28 (Pupil PDF worksheet: my recitation stars chart)
intro: Lesson 28: Welcome back: Al-Humazah and Al-'Asr after the break. Recite this week's ayat to a grown-up every day. Colour a star when you recite with no mistake; the grown-up writes their initials.

head: Star
What the teacher listens for
rows: I say every word in the right order
Each letter comes from the right place
Fathah, kasrah and dammah are clear
I sit nicely, start with isti'adhah and Bismillah

panels.title: Al-Humazah together
points: Slowly, one ayah at a time
